findings.before: A selected bundle could contain a self or circular dependency graph and still report MINIMUM_SUFFICIENT_BUNDLE_SELECTED when every referenced dependency ID was present.
findings.after: Selected dependency graphs are cycle-checked. Self and multi-node cycles fail closed as CAPABILITY_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE and acquisition routing is withheld pending dependency resolution.

deterministicCoverageAdded: two-node circular dependency rejected even when both IDs are selected
complete acyclic dependency graph remains eligible
